intro: Wizbang Cranktoggle, a gnome inventor nursing a hangover in Auberdine, needs help retrieving a box of lost hardware he tossed into the sea. Having fled the clatter of Ironforge for the quiet shores of Kalimdor, he managed to drop his vital gaffer jacks overboard during the voyage. Anyone with a fishing rod and patience can dredge up these missing components along the coastline.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I came to Auberdine because of the quiet. I want to invent my inventions where it's quiet, because after a night of drinking I don't like all the noise of Ironforge!
So I took a ship to Auberdine and had a little too much to drink on the way. I dropped my box of gaffer jacks overboard! I need my gaffer jacks!
I don't know exactly where I dropped them, but if you fish for them in the ocean you might get lucky...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find my gaffer jacks, friend? Without my gaffer jacks I can't tune my stintle pegs!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can't believe you found them! You must be the luckiest traveler in Kalimdor!
